appearances.title: Unlimited OCR 2 parses book-length documents in one request
appearances.summary: Baidu released Unlimited OCR 2, an open parser whose SR-SWA mechanism keeps very long documents inside a fixed context window, with nearly constant decode latency and memory as length grows. It reports state-of-the-art scores on MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench, and SGLang is the recommended server.
